schema.description: Segmented transfer envelope stream containing the requested payload segment and trailing footer metadata.
Segmented transfer envelope stream containing serialized PutTransferSegmentRequest metadata followed by the segment payload bytes.
Stream transfer envelope stream containing the requested payload segment and trailing footer metadata.
Stream transfer envelope stream containing serialized PutStreamTransferSegmentRequest metadata followed by the segment payload bytes.

AbortTransferRequest.description: Request to delete a staged segmented transfer session.

Aborted.description: Whether staged transfer resources were removed.

AbortTransferResponse.description: Response indicating whether a staged segmented transfer was aborted.

CommitUploadTransferRequest.description: Request final validation and publication of a fully realized staged transfer.

CommitUploadTransferResponse.description: Response describing the post-commit state of a staged transfer session.

oneOf.description: Optional refined object summary to publish at completion.

FinalObjectPayload.description: Optional refined serialized object payload to publish at completion.

FinalObjectSHA512.description: Optional SHA-512 of the refined serialized object payload.

FinalStreamLength.description: Optional final stream length declared by the caller.

FinalStreamSHA512.description: Optional final SHA-512 declared by the caller.

CompleteStreamTransferRequest.description: Request final validation and publication of a stream-transfer session.

CompleteStreamTransferResponse.description: Response describing the post-completion state of a stream-transfer session.

ItemID.description: Immutable data item identifier associated with the transfer session.

oneOf.description: Finite segmented transfer state when the session is backed by segmented transport.
Stream transfer state when the session is backed by stream transport.

TransferFamily.description: Transfer family currently backing the server session.

DataControlServerSessionInfo.description: Transfer session inspection record returned by session inventory APIs.

DataControlTransferFamily.description: Client transfer family used to route and interpret transfer sessions.

DataItemTransferIdentity.description: Identity for a segmented transfer session.

DataItemTransferMode.description: Transfer session role used to interpret transfer state and behavior.

ContentStreamed.description: Whether the data item uses streamed content.

DataItemTransferObjectInfo.description: Small descriptive summary of the serialized data item associated with a transfer.

Offset.description: Starting byte offset of the range.

Length.description: Length in bytes of the range.

EndOffsetExclusive.description: Exclusive ending offset of the range.

IsEmpty.description: Whether the range length is zero.

DataItemTransferRange.description: Half-open byte range within a staged transfer stream.

MinSegmentBytes.description: Minimum allowed payload size in bytes.

MaxSegmentBytes.description: Maximum allowed payload size in bytes.

DataItemTransferSegmentSizePolicy.description: Advertised segment size guidance for a staged transfer session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload.

SourceSessionID.description: Optional source session identifier for follower read sessions.

StreamSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the complete stream payload.

DataItemTransferState.description: Current state view of a staged segmented transfer session.

AppendedLength.description: Current durable appended length in bytes.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload when present.

SourceSessionID.description: Optional source session identifier for follower sessions.

StreamSHA512.description: Optional final SHA-512 of the durable stream payload.

DataStreamTransferState.description: State view describing the current status of an append or follow stream-transfer session.

Length.description: Requested read payload length in bytes.

Offset.description: Requested read offset within the durable appended prefix.

GetStreamTransferSegmentRequest.description: Metadata carried in a stream-transfer segment read request.

GetStreamTransferStateResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a stream-transfer session.

Length.description: Requested read payload length in bytes.

GetTransferSegmentRequest.description: Metadata carried in a segmented transfer read request.

ItemID.description: Optional immutable data item identifier filter.

oneOf.description: Optional transfer status filter applied to the current session state.

GetTransferSessionsRequest.description: Administrative request used to query DataControl transfer session inventory.

GetTransferStateResponse.description: Response containing the current staged transfer state.

OpenFollowStreamTransferRequest.description: Request to create a follower stream-transfer session over an active source session.

ObjectPayload.description: Serialized source object payload used to reconstruct the followed data item.

OpenFollowStreamTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a follower stream-transfer session.

SourceSessionID.description: Optional staged upload session identifier when opening a follower read session over active staged content.

OpenGetTransferRequest.description: Request to create a new readable segmented session over committed published content.

ObjectPayload.description: Serialized data item payload bound to the committed readable session.

OpenGetTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a committed-read segmented session.

ObjectPayload.description: Optional serialized object payload used to initialize the stream-transfer session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload when present.

OpenStreamTransferRequest.description: Request to create a new source stream-transfer session.

OpenStreamTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a source stream-transfer session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload.

StreamSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the complete stream payload.

OpenUploadTransferRequest.description: Request to create a new staged segmented upload session.

OpenUploadTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a staged segmented upload session.

AppendedLength.description: Current durable appended length after processing the request.

PutStreamTransferSegmentResponse.description: Metadata carried in a stream-transfer segment append response.

CompletedCoverage.description: Whether full logical coverage exists after acceptance.

Range.description: Logical range associated with this upload result.

PutTransferSegmentResponse.description: Metadata carried in a segmented upload envelope response.

RemoveTransferRequest.description: Request to remove retained transfer session state.

Removed.description: Whether retained transfer resources were removed.

RemoveTransferResponse.description: Response indicating whether retained transfer session resources were removed.

ReOpenFollowStreamTransferRequest.description: Request to reattach to an existing follower stream-transfer session.

ObjectPayload.description: Serialized source object payload used to reconstruct the followed data item.

ReOpenFollowStreamTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a reopened follower stream-transfer session.

StreamSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the committed stream payload expected by the caller.

ReOpenGetTransferRequest.description: Request to reattach to an existing readable segmented session.

ObjectPayload.description: Serialized data item payload bound to the readable session.

ReOpenGetTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a reopened readable segmented session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload when present.

StreamSHA512.description: Optional final SHA-512 when reopening a finalized stream-transfer session.

ReOpenStreamTransferRequest.description: Request to reattach to an existing source stream-transfer session.

ReOpenStreamTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a reopened source stream-transfer session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload.

StreamSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the complete stream payload.

ReOpenUploadTransferRequest.description: Request to reattach to an existing staged segmented upload session.

ReOpenUploadTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a reopened staged segmented upload session.
